# Scenario 12 — Update Walk, Add Atorvastatin, and Medicine Query

## Context
Robert has shown good tolerance to his morning walks. His doctor wants to extend the duration and add more days to improve weight management. The doctor also wants to add Atorvastatin for cardiovascular risk reduction.

## Objectives
1. Update the morning walk (wl_001) to last 45 minutes instead of 30.
2. Add Tuesday and Thursday to the walk's days of week, so it runs Monday through Friday.
3. Ask the assistant whether Atorvastatin is safe for Robert given his Type 2 Diabetes and Obesity (without requesting to add it yet).
4. After the assistant confirms it is safe, add Atorvastatin as a medication, 20mg, every day at 20:00 after dinner, with a dependency on 'di_001'.
5. Confirm all changes.
